# TrustedQSL .tq8 (GAbbI) fixtures

Generated by `tqsl_getConverterGABBI` from Debian `trustedqsl` **2.8.7-1**,
configuration 11.35, on amd64, reusing the `localhost/go-gabbi-tq5-fixture`
container image built from `testdata/tq5/Containerfile`.

All private keys, CA material, and `.p12` containers are disposable, created
strictly inside `/tmp/work` in the container, and never exported. Only the
uncompressed GAbbI `.gabbi` outputs are written to the output directory.

## Cases

All cases use a US station for `KF0TST` (DXCC `291`) with lowercase
`GRIDSQUARE` (`em10dh`), `CQZ` (`4`), `ITUZ` (`7`), `IOTA` (`na-001`),
`US_STATE` (`TX`), and `US_COUNTY` (`Travis`).

1. `normal.gabbi`: Two CW contacts (`contacts.adi`: `W1AW` 2026-11-01, `K1ABC`
   2026-11-02) with a single certificate covering `2020-01-01` through
   `2035-12-31`.
2. `chained.gabbi`: Same two CW contacts with a chained ADIF mode map
   (`CW -> SSB`, `SSB -> DATA`), showing TrustedQSL's mode re-mapping after
   emitting `tCERT` and `tSTATION` records.
3. `switch.gabbi`: Two disposable RSA-1024 certificates for `KF0TST` DXCC `291`
   (Cert A: `2020-01-01`..`2025-12-31`, serial `12345`; Cert B:
   `2026-01-01`..`2035-12-31`, serial `12346`) and four CW contacts
   (`switch.adi`) selecting A, A, B, A (`2025-11-01`, `2025-11-02`,
   `2026-11-01`, `2025-11-03`).
4. `switch-chained.gabbi`: Same A, A, B, A contacts with the chained mode map
   `CW -> SSB`, `SSB -> DATA`.
5. `dupe-preamble.gabbi`: Seeds the container's `TQSLDIR` duplicate database by
   committing `W1AW` `2026-11-01` (`dupe-seed.adi`, Cert B), then converts a
   two-contact ADIF (`dupe-preamble.adi`) whose first contact is that duplicate
   (Cert B) and whose second contact is a new contact on Cert A (`K1NEW`
   `2025-11-01`), capturing every record returned by `tqsl_getConverterGABBI`,
   including the `tCERT`/`tSTATION` preamble that remains when
   `TQSL_DUPLICATE_QSO` is returned.

## Regenerating

Run:

```sh
sh testdata/tq8/generate.sh EMPTY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
```

If `localhost/go-gabbi-tq5-fixture` already exists, generation runs completely
offline (`--network=none`) with a fresh temporary `TQSLDIR` per case and fresh
disposable keys. Outputs contain random keys, timestamps, and signatures and
will not be byte-identical between runs. Inspect regenerated output before
replacing checked-in fixtures; never edit a fixture to make a failing test pass.

To verify freshly generated output without replacing the checked-in fixtures:

```sh
GABBI_TQ8_FIXTURE_DIR=EMPTY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY CGO_ENABLED=0 go test -run TestSignTrustedQSLGolden -count=1
```
